title: Context Index Schema
description: Machine-readable index for .claude/context/ files enabling automated context discovery via jq queries

generated.description: ISO8601 timestamp when index was last generated

entries.description: Array of indexed context file entries

entry.$comment: description, tags, and tier are deliberately ABSENT from this entry shape, not oversights: 'description' duplicates 'summary' and its unique detail is meant to be folded into 'summary' (not carried as a second free-text field); 'tags' is a naming mismatch for the already-declared 'keywords' property below (use 'keywords'); 'tier' is meant to be derived algorithmically from load_when shape rather than hand-authored, since no entry in practice ever populated it accurately. additionalProperties stays false so these cannot silently reappear. The 'on_demand' property below is the explicit-intent marker consumed by validate-context-budgets.sh's Dead Entry Check, and it exists precisely BECAUSE tier is derived: deriving Tier 4 from an all-empty load_when means 'never auto-loaded' can no longer be distinguished from 'not Tier 4', which would reduce that check to a tautology that can never fire. Requiring the author to state the intent keeps 'deliberately grep-only' separable from 'someone forgot to hook this up'.

path.description: Relative path from .claude/context/ to the file

subdomain.description: Subdomain within the domain (e.g., orchestration, formats, meta)

topics.description: Semantic topics covered by this file

summary.description: Brief summary of file contents (max 200 chars)

line_count.description: Approximate line count for context budget estimation

load_when.description: Conditions for automatic loading. Closed key set: agents / commands / task_types / always -- languages and skills were removed as never-queried at runtime (their only historical consumers were defensive exclusions in validate-context-budgets.sh's dead-entry guard); additionalProperties stays false so a future undeclared discriminator is forbidden rather than silently accepted.

agents.description: Agents that should load this context

commands.description: Commands that should load this context

task_types.description: Task types that trigger loading -- the primary task-type discriminator (supersedes the removed 'languages' key)

always.description: If true, always load this context for the specified domain

deprecated.description: If true, file is deprecated and should be avoided

replacement.description: Path to replacement file if deprecated

on_demand.description: If true, this entry is deliberately reachable only on demand (grep/explicit Read), not through any automatic load_when hook. Optional; absence means false. Set it ONLY on an entry whose load_when hooks are all empty by design -- it is the explicit-intent marker that exempts such an entry from validate-context-budgets.sh's Dead Entry Check. An all-hooks-empty entry WITHOUT this marker is still reported as dead, which is the intended signal.
